reviews.title: SoundMixer.stopAll stops timeline and scripted sounds
reviews.summary: SoundMixer.stopAll() stops timeline frame sounds and AS3 Sound channels in the shared runtime and the HTML5 host, proven by the sound-playback family through the shipped host and a compiled AS3 project.

entries.note: Only stopAll(); soundTransform, bufferTime, computeSpectrum, areSoundsInaccessible and audioPlaybackMode are missing.

reviews.title: stopAllSounds stops timeline sounds
reviews.summary: stopAllSounds() stops every playing timeline frame sound and scripted Sound, and streams resume at their timeline position on the next frame, proven by the sound-playback family through the shipped HTML5 host.
